slides.head: Every Woman Should Have Something She Can Call Her Own.
body: A skill. A career. A business. Something that gives her the opportunity to earn.

slides.head: There's Nothing Wrong With Being Supported.
body: !But you should also be intentional about building something for yourself.

slides.head: Life Can Change.
body: The people supporting you today may not always be in a position to do so.
!Build something you can fall back on.

slides.head: Your Ability to Earn Gives You Options.
body: !To meet your needs, make decisions, pursue opportunities, and support others.

slides.head: You Don't Have to Start Big.
body: Learn one skill. Practise. Build experience.
!Start where you are and grow from there.

slides.head: Financial Independence Doesn't Mean Doing Everything Alone.
body: !You can receive support, be loved, and still have your own income and goals.

slides.head: Invest in the Woman You're Becoming.
body: Learn that skill. Take that opportunity. Build something for yourself.

caption:
Support is a gift. Building something of your own is a choice you can make alongside it, whatever stage you're at.

What's one skill you're building for yourself this year? Tell us in the comments.
